scope: Reporting groups for every fuel at the coal plants (tracker issues #32, #33 and #51 theme 4). Each source's own fuel label maps to one group, or is excluded from generation with a reason. The extractors keep the source labels; this list is the only place that turns them into groups, so a change of categories needs no re-extraction. A label that is neither grouped nor excluded fails the view refresh, so a new label is decided here, never guessed. Decided by N. Abad on 2026-11-09 after C. Shearer's comments of 2026-10-28 on #32 and #33 (petcoke is not coal; batteries out for now): Other fossil = petcoke; oil is its own group; a pumped-storage station's output counts as hydro.
